# LearnForEarn
> Online learning platform for tech students at every stage

LearnForEarn is a learning platform for anyone who wants
to grow in tech. It serves beginners learning to code for
the first time, students improving their skills, developers
building real projects, students preparing for placement
tests, and anyone exploring AI tools and modern development
practices. Based in India, used by students across all
stages of their tech learning journey.

## What students come here for
- Learning to code from scratch
- Practicing DSA and coding problems at every level
- Building real projects for their portfolio
- Preparing for placement aptitude and coding tests
- Following structured career roadmaps for every tech role
- Learning AI tools like GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT
- Deploying projects live for the first time
- Practicing aptitude for placement and competitive exams
- Understanding which tech role to pursue

## Platform sections
- Aptitude Lab: Quantitative, Logical, Verbal, Data Interpretation
- Code GYM: Coding problems from beginner to advanced
- Mission Board: Guided real projects at every skill level
- AI Lab: AI tools for modern developers
- Career Guidance: Role roadmaps for every tech path
- Deploy Guidance: How to deploy any project live

## Who uses it
Beginners, students, freshers, self-learners, career
switchers, developers improving skills, students preparing
for competitive exams and placements in India.
